CustomField.description: What happens when a person's address is edited: the household moves together, or that person gets an address of their own. Canonical model R-AD5. Held as text because a custom setting field cannot be a picklist; the settings console offers the two values.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose Update household so everyone in the household moves together, or Create personal address so only that person moves.
CustomField.label: When a person's address is edited
